derivation: contracted from a compound of G735 (Ἄρτεμις) and G1435 (δῶρον);
def: gift of Artemis; Artemas (or Artemidorus), a Christian

occurrences.text: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
